summary: Updated idempotency hashing so requests without a click limit retain the exact pre-deployment hash format, preserving replay compatibility for existing keys.
rationale: When maxClicks is null or omitted, LinkService now hashes the legacy three-property request shape. Requests with a click limit continue to hash the full request, so the limit remains part of idempotency comparison. Tests are owned by the Tester and were not changed.
content:
### Implemented

No-limit idempotency replays now use the legacy request serialization (`LongUrl`, `CustomAlias`, `ExpiresAt`) when calculating the request hash. Requests that specify `maxClicks` still hash the complete request.

### Test ownership

I did not add or modify tests because the project instructions reserve test files for the Tester. The implementation continues to accept requests that omit `maxClicks`; the requested regression test and omitted-field API test remain for that stage.
